officialSources.role: National ATR/BPN public land and spatial map viewer
officialSources.observation: Official shell returned HTTP 200 and delegates the interactive map to the current konsolbhumi.atrbpn.go.id console. BHUMI help documents land-parcel map elements and warns that displayed data is not guaranteed complete or fully current.

Current console HTML and JavaScript assets returned HTTP 200 with browser headers. Static asset inspection found no directly usable anonymous parcel feature endpoint or safe schema response; no token value was retained.

officialSources.observation: Official local land-office host is evidenced by an ATR/BPN Kota Probolinggo document route; the discovered material concerns land-office transaction/map forms, not an open parcel API.

viewerRoute.mapLayerObservation: Official help identifies bidang tanah (land parcels) as a map element and coordinate display, but the anonymous request review did not obtain a safe ID+geometry feature response.

geometryDecision.reason: No bounded anonymous response containing a safe native parcel identity and full polygon was obtained. The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted. No exact-point miss or viewer limitation is treated as citywide absence.
